items.question: Will I have to replace my POS?
items.answer: No, the POS stays yours. Nyambot doesn't replace it and doesn't require one. With iiko or R-Keeper you connect the integration, and the menu, stop lists and orders sync automatically. With a different POS or none at all, Nyambot runs the menu, modifiers, loyalty and orders on its own, in its own CRM. Connect a POS later — your data stays in place

items.question: Do I need a separate bot for each location?
items.answer: No. In each messenger, one bot serves the whole chain: the guest picks a location — by geolocation or from a list — and sees the menu, prices and delivery zone of exactly that location. You promote one channel, and a new location goes live without a separate launch. The guest base, order history and points stay shared across the whole chain

items.question: Does Nyambot bring in guests?
items.answer: No — and that's the point. Nyambot is the venue's own ordering app, under your name. We don't drive traffic — we land yours: ads, social media, bloggers, search, your sign and your packaging. The difference from an aggregator is not where the guest came from, but whose guest they are afterwards: someone who orders on a marketplace stays its guest — with a 25–35% commission on every next order — while someone who comes to Nyambot follows your venue's bot and orders again directly

items.question: Who will set everything up?
items.answer: We do — for free. Leave a launch request: we'll get in touch within 24 hours, set up your account, menu, POS and delivery, create your Telegram bot and check everything with test orders. You open the MAX bot yourself, on your own sole proprietorship or LLC, via a link we send — and we'll connect it. All prices are on this page. After that you run everything in the CRM, with Anya and support to help.

items.question: Can a guest message the venue?
items.answer: Yes, if guest chat is turned on for the location. The guest writes to the bot: AI answers the usual questions, and the admin on shift handles the rest from Telegram or MAX

items.question: Won't the AI say too much?
items.answer: The AI answers only from your location's data and this guest's orders. It doesn't promise discounts or refunds, and it doesn't change or cancel orders — such questions go to the admin. Other guests' orders and contacts are not visible to it

items.question: How do I find out that the POS has stopped accepting orders?
items.answer: Turn on notifications in the CRM: «Profile» → «Notifications». A message arrives in Telegram or MAX as soon as the POS stops responding, and another one when it's working again

items.question: How do the trial period and payment at the start work?
items.answer: 30 days free, no card and no cut-down features. After sign-up you get full access: the full CRM, the Team app, POS and delivery integrations. You can set everything up yourself or leave the launch to us — it's free, and support answers your questions at every step. The trial runs on standard terms — one location and two bots; integrations connect without limits. Chains and large volumes are discussed separately

items.question: How do I get 50% off?
items.answer: Write to us before your first payment — we'll lock it in. The discount for the first 3 months is for those who already use a paid ordering or delivery service. Write to us before paying and confirm which service you use — we'll lock in the price, and you'll see it in the CRM under «License». The discount is calculated from the full plan price, doesn't stack with other discounts or the savings of longer plans, and the three months count from your first payment — the trial isn't part of them and comes before them
